answer: Stake-weighted identity is a concrete Sybil defense: each AI agent locks a bond to earn one vote, so influence is priced, not free. An attacker needing N fake identities must post N bonds, making cost linear in Sybils, and each bond is slashable on detection, adding risk. A gale can cut the cable to an island, and nectar can bait honest agents, but neither manufactures locked capital.
